inlines.v: PEN'ETRATING, participle present tense Entering; piercing; understanding. 1. adjective Having the power of entering or piercing another body; sharp; subtil. Oil is a penetrating substance. 2. Acute; discerning; quick to understand; as a penetrating mind.
